example.title: While source partitions wait for retry

narrative: Read `spec.request.snapshotRef.kind` first. Table and graph builds report different workflow checks. A missing target, identity mismatch, or competing build can set a failure before refreshing conditions. Check `status.phase`, `status.executionPhase`, and `status.failure` together. For a failed connector plan, read `status.failure.suggestedAction` and `status.connector.lastPlanningFailure`. For `InvalidGraphPublication`, read `status.failure.message` for the graph field or inventory rule rejected during finalization, then check the data-job and operator contract versions. A reported controlConcurrency value is the per-replica planning limit. Reserved planning limits describe caps, and do not identify which counter was exceeded. When `status.failure.code` is `ExecutionPodUnschedulable`, the Pod is waiting for an eligible node. Compare the build's `spec.request.placementTemplateRef` and the Pod's resource requests with node labels, taints, affinity rules and available capacity.

outcomes.guidance: The workflow accepted the specification. A dependency can still delay execution.
The table build verified the canonical snapshot artifact. Read the parent publication for the committed result.
Shutdown ended while remote work was uncertain. Inspect the build’s cleanup disposition before retrying.
The workflow finished shutdown. Inspect the build cleanup state before submitting a replacement.
Inspect the dependency named in the message and check its status before retrying.
The table build resolved its dependencies.
The table build is stopping. Check cleanup before starting another attempt.
Inspect scheduling events for the workflow’s worker pods. Check their resource requests and available node capacity.
The attempt is active. Follow its workflow reference to see which step is running.
Inspect the dependency named in the message and check its status before retrying.
The table build is stopping. Check cleanup before starting another attempt.
The workflow stopped after cancellation. Check cleanup before retrying.
The connector reported runtime overload. Read the partition count and earliest window retry eligibility from status.connector.partitionBackoff.
Partition backoff cleared. Follow the current source read through to workflow handoff or a terminal result.
The attempt is active. Follow its workflow reference to see which step is running.
Read the build failure and the referenced workflow for the failed step.
The workflow finished successfully. Check the parent snapshot’s publication before consuming the result.
